column1: #mapping_set_title: CALM to NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 class mappings

#mapping_set_description: Schema-level mappings between the FINOS Common Architecture Language Model (CALM 1.2) and the NIST Special Publication 800-53 Revision 5 Security and Privacy Controls LinkML schema. CALM Control maps closely to the SP 800-53 Control class; ControlRequirement maps to ControlEnhancement (the structured sub-control); Architecture maps broadly to the Catalog container.

column7: A CALM Control is a named, domain-scoped requirement on an architecture element with a requirement-url and configuration; an SP 800-53 Control is a structured security or privacy safeguard with statement, supplemental guidance, and control enhancements - both represent the fundamental bounded control unit.

A CALM ControlRequirement specifies the metadata schema for a control domain; an SP 800-53 ControlEnhancement adds scoped additional capability to a base control - related as both add specificity to the base control construct.

A CALM Architecture document contains all nodes, relationships, and control overlays; an SP 800-53 Catalog is the organised collection of security and privacy controls - both are the top-level containers for their respective control collections.

A CALM ControlDetail attaches implementation-specific configuration to a control requirement reference; an SP 800-53 ControlGroup clusters related controls - related in that both provide organisational context for individual controls.
